scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c green,blue "npm run server" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.release:win: npm run build && mkdir -p release && cp -R frontend/dist release/dist && cd backend && GOOS=windows GOARCH=amd64 go build -ldflags="-s -w" -o ../release/CFC.exe ./cmd/cfc-server
scripts.release:mac: npm run build && mkdir -p release && cp -R frontend/dist release/dist && cd backend && go build -ldflags="-s -w" -o ../release/CFC ./cmd/cfc-server
